copy.headline: Work session, special called meeting scheduled Dec. 1
copy.caption:
The Fort Worth City Council will hold a work session at 2 p.m. Tuesday, Dec. 1. The meeting will be held at City Hall, 100 Fort Worth Trail.

City Council will hold a special called meeting at noon Tuesday in the Council Chamber at City Hall to discuss Lebow Flood Mitigation Texas Water Development Board grant acceptance.
